seo.title_text: Telangana's Top Solar Panel Installation Company | Sri Balaji Solar Energies.

platform: React single-page application (create-react-app build: static/media bundles, manifest.json, theme-color #000000) with slick, swiper, AOS, GSAP and WOW.js loaded in the shell; GA4 G-C58ZMRZ68Q and GTM container GTM-NCP9G6SM are the only tags in the served head
html_errors: 0 errors, 1 warning and 11 info messages on the served HTML - the cleanest markup in this audit, because the served page is a shell: one <div id="root"> holding a loader GIF, with the entire site rendered client-side by React. Nothing on the page - no heading, no form, no button, no price, no testimonial - is present in the HTML the server returns.
scope_note: www.sribalajisolarenergies.com is a React single-page application. The server returns a shell - doctype, head, a loader GIF and the script bundles - and every heading, form, button, testimonial and price renders only after JavaScript runs. The W3C checker and a direct page fetch therefore see no content, which is why every conversion row reads 'Not checked': those rows are unmeasured, not absent. The two tags that ARE in the shell - GA4 G-C58ZMRZ68Q and GTM GTM-NCP9G6SM - were read directly from the served head.

issues: Your entire website is invisible to everything that is not a browser: the served HTML is a React shell with a loader GIF, no h1, no headings, no form and no content. Google's crawler, the W3C checker, every link preview and every accessibility tool see an empty page.

You run about 8 live Meta ads - every one of them clicking through to fb.me, none to your own site - while your site carries no Meta Pixel. You are paying to reach people and then handing them to Facebook's messenger with no way to bring them back.

Your live ads contradict each other on your own history: Library ID 942037648839408 says '14 years of trust' while 1454295123168911 and 1541931104220931 say '15 years legacy'. Two ages, running at the same time.

GA4 (G-C58ZMRZ68Q) and GTM (GTM-NCP9G6SM) are both installed in the shell - real measurement that most leads in this market do not have - but there is no Meta Pixel and no Google Ads tag, so the one measurement you have covers the channel you do not buy.

Three different phone numbers appear across your live ads (+91-85200 27111, +91-91333 03164) and two more in our own register (+91 9959491774, +91 87024 44646), and every ad lands on the same fb.me redirect - a buyer has no way to tell which number is yours.
No Meta Pixel installed — can't run retargeting or track ad conversions

promise_gap: Meta Ad Library: about 8 active ad results on the Sri Balaji Solar Energies page (queried 2026-11-10), including Library IDs 942037648839408 and 1454295123168911 and 1541931104220931 (running since May 29, 2026), 2103721667197349 (since Aug 18, 2026) and 4493621594235361 (since Aug 25, 2026).
Every one of them clicks to fb.me, not to the site - and the site carries no Meta Pixel. The ads are the entire front door, and the house behind them renders nothing without JavaScript.

The Telugu ad copy promises 'no more current bills to pay', 'Rs. 0 (zero) upfront cost', 'central government subsidy up to Rs. 78,000', 'pay just Rs. 1,355 EMI instead of a monthly current bill' and '10,000+ satisfied customers', with service listed across Warangal, Hanumakonda, Rajahmundry, Bhadrachalam, Ghatkesar, Huzurabad, Hyderabad and nearby districts.

Those are specific, checkable promises - and the page they should lead to cannot be read without JavaScript, so a buyer who taps through to the site instead of fb.me gets a loader. The same ads give the company's age as both 14 years and 15 years.
Google's Ads Transparency Centre returns zero ads for sribalajisolarenergies.com (queried 2026-11-10) - all of the paid activity is on Meta.

That is a defensible channel choice for a Telugu-first residential offer, and GA4 (G-C58ZMRZ68Q) plus GTM (GTM-NCP9G6SM) are both installed in the shell, so the measurement side is the strongest of the four leads in this audit. What is missing is any way to measure the Meta side: no Meta Pixel was read in the served head.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
